title: What is the ratio of male to female patients among all those with abnormal
question:
What is the ratio of male to female patients among all those with abnormal uric acid counts?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: male refers to SEX = 'M'; female refers to SEX = 'F'; abnormal uric acid refers to UA < = '8.0' where SEX = 'M', UA < = '6.5' where SEX = 'F'; calculation = DIVIDE(SUM(UA <= '8.0' and SEX = 'M'), SUM(UA <= '6.5 and SEX = 'F'))

prediction.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_022 <= 8.0 AND P.XCL_059 = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_022 <= 6.5 AND P.XCL_059 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Laboratory AS "L" JOIN Patient AS "P" ON "L".XCL_014 = "P".XCL_058

arguments.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_022 <= 8.0 AND P.XCL_059 = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
  /
  SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_022 <= 6.5 AND P.XCL_059 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058;

WHERE l.XCL_020 > 7.0 OR l.XCL_020 < 2.0
